fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./internal/index/... : a Go test writes a log whose change set has an entry of format N+1 followed by later entries (a land included), opens the index with the entry format version seen as N and asserts the newer-format problem and the left-out entries, then opens the same index file (unchanged log, so the stat fingerprint matches) with the version seen as N+1 and asserts the change set folds landed with no problems, equal to changeset.FoldLog over the log; a second open at the same version does not rebuild; the package doc in internal/index/index.go lists an entry format change among the rebuild causes
fields.statement: The persistent index records the entry format version it decoded the log with, and an Open by a binary whose entry.FormatVersion differs (the fast stat-fingerprint path included) rebuilds it from nothing, so entries stored with a newer-format problem by an older binary are decoded again and their change sets fold as the log says
